Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Slopball3D browser published-party restore

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓
Shell
REPLAY_SLOPBALL3D_PARTY_RESTORE_OUT=/absolute/fresh/output \
  nix develop --command bash tests/replay_slopball3d_party_restore/run.sh

The runner covers restoration by the original creator and by the trusted player in seat two. Both cases start three named players plus an observer and publish a scored, moving/spinning world. Every source browser and the service are SIGKILLed; exit signals/codes are checked. The service reopens its database with creation disabled. An independent reader validates the complete checkpoint, tick/digest, body scopes/frontiers, score/names and ball position/quaternion/velocity vectors.

The observer registers first and cannot become authority. The selected trusted member restores the exact saved world in epoch two. Its first actual solver seed must match the independent checkpoint within 0.0001 for position/velocities and a quaternion dot magnitude above 0.99999. Nonzero horizontal speed, angular speed and nontrivial orientation are required in the source checkpoint.

The creator returns only after restoration when seat two hosts. All original seats and names return. The new authority must make another kick and score for its team, then publish revision two; the independent decoder checks the new authority seat and publisher as well as the complete continued world. Guest publication is refused. Named observer chat, common world hashes, RTC traffic, graphics traces, control layout and absence of browser-local save slots are checked.

RS3_RESTORE_OWNER=host or striker selects one case when using execute.py WEB_BUILD SERVICE_BUILD FRESH_OUTPUT. The injected observer invokes normal actions and reads the real game; it does not inject a checkpoint or world. Raw browser profiles, databases and credentials are private test state. Retain redacted events, logs, source hashes and decoded receipts when sharing results. Public deployment, arbitrary failure sequences and solver contact-cache rollback remain outside this local acceptance gate.
